name: tr_kawhi
caption:
IF KAWHI HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🦀 Kingler: one claw grew massive and steel-hard. 11-inch hands, nicknamed the Claw
🛡️ Aggron: claims a whole mountain, thrashes any trespasser. Defensive Player of the Year in 2014 and 2015
⚔️ Gallade: senses what its foe is thinking and strikes first. 2014 title and Finals MVP
🏀 Spoink: never stops bouncing, even asleep. Game 7 at the buzzer, four bounces, the first Game 7 buzzer-beater ever
🕊️ Unfezant: close to no one but its own Trainer. Traded back to us, 23 points and 4 steals in his first game back
🧊 Mewtwo: stays motionless, then unleashes full power. Our 2019 title, his second Finals MVP

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Kawhi Leonard had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF KAWHI HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Kingler. One of its claws grew massive and hard as steel. Kawhi's got eleven-inch hands. If it's loose, it's his.
Aggron. It claims a whole mountain and thrashes anything that trespasses. Defensive Player of the Year. Twice.
Gallade. It senses what its foe is thinking, so it strikes first. Twenty fourteen, with the Spurs: a title, and Finals MVP.
beats.dlg: READS FOES, STRIKES FIRST.|2014 TITLE AND FINALS MVP!

beats.vo: Spoink. It never stops bouncing, not even in its sleep. Game seven, at the buzzer. Four bounces... and in.
beats.dlg: IT NEVER STOPS BOUNCING.|GAME 7 BUZZER: 4 BOUNCES!

beats.vo: Unfezant. It won't get close to anyone but its own Trainer. He came back to us. Hurt right now, but his first game back? Twenty-three points, four steals.
beats.dlg: LOYAL ONLY TO ITS TRAINER.|FIRST GAME: 23 PTS, 4 STL

beats.vo: And the ace. Mewtwo. It stays still to save energy, then unleashes full power in battle. Twenty nineteen: our first title, and his second Finals MVP.
beats.dlg: STILL, THEN FULL POWER.|2019 FINALS MVP!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Leonard: nicknamed the Claw for ball-hawking and exceptionally large hands, 11-inch hands; 2 (two) times NBA Defensive Player of the Year (2014, 2015); 2 NBA titles and 2 Finals MVPs (2014 with the Spurs, 2019 with the Raptors, their first NBA championship, his second Finals MVP); in the deciding game 7 vs the 76ers he hit a corner shot at the buzzer that bounced off the rim four (4) times, the first game 7 buzzer beater in NBA history, normally stoic; selected 15th overall (#15) in 2011; September 14, 2026 traded back to the Raptors; October 27, 2026 out with swelling in his left knee
